1 Executive Summary & Architecture
Candidate: Muhammad Afaq (FA23-BSE-012)
🌐 Live App: https://quizmaster-pro-zeta.vercel.app/
📁 GitHub: web-Technology-Assignment-1

QuizMaster Pro is an interactive educational assessment web application engineered with vanilla HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript ES6+, and Bootstrap 5 for university course CSC336. The platform fulfills all CLO2 requirements through modular single-page architecture, resilient timer state handling, interactive segmented progress indicators, synthesized audio effects, and client-side vector PDF generation.

Core System Implementation Details Verification
Question Bank 40 curated MCQs covering HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript ES6+, and Bootstrap 5 ✔ 100% Unique & Verified
Timer Engine Timestamp-based drift-free countdown timer with urgency warning tick ✔ Drift-Free Accuracy
Audio System Web Audio API mechanical typewriter keystrokes & answer chimes ✔ Zero External Audio Assets
Vector PDF Engine Client-side multi-page PDF generation via jsPDF with auto-wrapping ✔ Clean Vector Tables
